notes: `מִשָּׁם` is one fused unit on *thence* here, since the ASV writes no separate word for the preposition and none for the adverb apart from it (rules 30, 40); the head is the adverb, which carries the lexeme.
The unmarked `הַר־אֶפְרַיִם` takes its supplied *unto* under rule 33 and its supplied *the* under rule 29, headed on *hill* (rule 31).
